boards.name: Avionte
boards.notes: Integrations page describes the Avionte+ program for third-party integrations. Home, about and integrations pages state no pricing, parent or language options.

sources.title: Integrations
sources.quote: Avionté+ is the program that allows best-of-breed technologies for staffing and recruiting to integrate with your core staffing platform.

boards.name: TE Recruit (Top Echelon)
boards.notes: Pricing page lists Standard and Professional subscription plans with month-to-month and annual billing. Professional plan includes API access per the pricing page. Integrations marketplace lists job board integrations.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: TE Recruit offers two different subscription plans to its users: the Standard plan and the Professional plan.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: When you opt for the Standard plan, the cost decreases from $95 to $79 per month.

sources.title: Integrations marketplace
sources.quote: See how TE Recruit ATS + CRM and our Integrations work together to grow your business.

sources.title: Integrations marketplace
sources.quote: TE Recruit™ integrates with Careerjet, allowing recruiters to post jobs on one of the world's most expansive job platforms

boards.name: Avature
boards.notes: Homepage has a Site Language control, but no language options appear in the page text. The integration framework and API pages are on avature.ai and state no access route for the APIs.

boards.name: Infor Talent Science
boards.notes: Infor is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Koch Industries. The Infor Partner Network page describes the partner program.

sources.title: About Infor timeline
sources.quote: Infor becomes a wholly-owned, standalone subsidiary of Koch Industries

sources.title: Infor Partner Network
sources.quote: The Infor Partner Network (IPN) Program supports our partners, empowering them to help customers achieve successful outcomes through cloud-modern strategies.

boards.name: ApplicantStack
boards.notes: Pricing page lists four monthly plans from $29.99 to $159.99 per month. Job boards page says job posts are uploaded to Indeed and JobTarget. Footer copyright reads Swipeclock, but no parent is stated.

sources.title: Job boards
sources.quote: Effortlessly upload job posts and updates from ApplicantStack to Indeed, JobTarget and more

boards.name: Taleez
boards.notes: Integrations page states the REST API and webhooks are available on all plans, with keys created in account settings. Taleez says it is connected to more than 90 job boards.

sources.title: Integrations and API
sources.quote: Les clés se génèrent dans les paramètres de votre compte, rubrique « API & Webhooks », avec des permissions réglables pour chaque clé.

sources.title: Integrations and API
sources.quote: Pour la diffusion de vos offres, Taleez est aussi relié à plus de 90 jobboards.

boards.name: softgarden
boards.notes: Homepage is in German and carries a language menu with Deutsch and English. No pricing model, parent company or headquarters country is stated on the homepage.

boards.name: Factorial ATS
boards.notes: Pricing page starts at $8 per user per month. API keys are generated from company settings, and OAuth 2.0 is also offered. Certification program lists integrations on the marketplace.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: Factorial starts at $8 per month, per user

sources.title: API getting started
sources.quote: You can start today: generate an API Key from company settings, or use OAuth 2.0 if you need finer access control.

sources.title: Integrations partner program
sources.quote: Expand your product's reach. Develop custom solutions using our public API or join our certification program to get featured directly on our global marketplace.

reviews.name: Avionte
reviews.note: Home, about and integrations pages were read; partner program confirmed and no pricing, parent or language options stated.

reviews.name: TE Recruit (Top Echelon)
reviews.note: Pricing, marketplace and about pages were read; subscription pricing and job board integrations are stated.

reviews.name: Avature
reviews.note: Homepage read in both fetch and browser reader; no pricing, headquarters or access route stated, and language options are not in the page text.

reviews.name: Infor Talent Science
reviews.note: Home, about and partners pages were read; Koch parent and partner network confirmed.

reviews.name: ApplicantStack
reviews.note: Home, pricing, partners and job boards pages were read; subscription pricing, partner program and job board upload confirmed.

reviews.name: Taleez
reviews.note: Home, integrations and jobboards pages were read; API key access and French-language site confirmed.

reviews.name: softgarden
reviews.note: Homepage was read; German-language site confirmed and no pricing, parent or headquarters stated on it.

reviews.name: Factorial ATS
reviews.note: Pricing, API and partner program pages were read; subscription pricing, API key access and partner program confirmed.
